recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No source follow-up is needed for FHIR-24913 unless a future work group decision changes the standards-status taxonomy or the version-management narrative.
issue_request: FHIR-24913 was a Published FHIR-core change request with a Persuasive with Modification resolution. It reported that versions.html#std-process said HL7 had four descriptive status terms while listing five, and also noted a stale Release 3 Trial Use statement on a page that was then part of the R4 release. The accepted resolution was to correct "four" to "five", keep Informative as a valid standards-status level, and treat the Release 3 reference as handled by a separate tracker for the R4 technical correction.
initial_application: Commit 5b261e8e3ff62c6fc4eb09afd284a1e7af5e03d8 changed source/versions.html from four to five descriptive terms and removed the stale Release 3 warning. Commit 67c4ba690d1c4aca555bf00d9f8ca9bdbbbb095e later mentioned FHIR-24913 and added the FHIR Release 5 version-list entry to the same page.
additional_context: The current source root narrative page source/versions.html is linked throughout the build as versions.html#std-process. It now says HL7 has five descriptive terms and no longer contains "HL7 has four descriptive terms" or "This release (Release 3)". FHIR-I minutes from 2019-10-14 corroborate the Persuasive with Modification vote and confirm that only some requested suggestions were accepted.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the current source already carries the five-term correction and omits the obsolete Release 3 text. Adding extra prose about Informative would be redundant with the existing five-term sentence and status table.
